segs.en: B. Grand Renaming

zh.ai: B. 盛大重命名

segs.en: On the monorail line, there are $$$n$$$ stations, numbered in order from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$.

zh.ai: 单轨铁路线路上有 $$$n$$$ 个车站，按照顺序编号为 $$$1$$$ 至 $$$n$$$。

segs.en: Each station $$$i$$$ has a name $$$s_i$$$ — a string of no more than 20 Latin letters. Each letter is written on a separate nameplate.

zh.ai: 每个车站 $$$i$$$ 都有一个名称 $$$s_i$$$，它是一个长度不超过 20 的拉丁字母字符串。每个字母分别写在一个独立的名牌上。

segs.en: As part of the urban infrastructure upgrade project, it was decided to rename all the stations to some new names. The order for renaming has already been signed and will take effect tomorrow. However, there is a problem: no one has had time to replace the names on the nameplates at the stations. Now it is your task.

zh.ai: 作为城市基础设施升级项目的一部分，决定将所有车站更名为一些新名称。更名命令已经签署，并将于明天生效。然而有一个问题：还没有人有时间更换车站站牌上的名称。现在这项任务交给你了。

segs.en: Unfortunately, there is no time to make new nameplates. Therefore, the only possible option is to move the nameplates from one station to another.

zh.ai: 遗憾的是，已经没有时间制作新的站名牌了。因此，唯一可行的办法是将站名牌从一个车站移到另一个车站。

segs.en: Formally, in one operation, you can choose two indices $$$1 \le i, j \le n$$$, as well as any letter from the string $$$s_i$$$, and move that letter to any position in the string $$$s_j$$$. This operation takes $$$1 + |i - j|$$$ precious units of time.

zh.ai: 形式化地说，在一次操作中，你可以选择两个下标 $$$1 \le i, j \le n$$$，以及字符串 $$$s_i$$$ 中的任意一个字符，并将该字符移动到字符串 $$$s_j$$$ 中的任意位置。该操作需要耗费 $$$1 + |i - j|$$$ 个宝贵的时间单位。

segs.en: For example, if $$$s_i = \texttt{ab}$$$ and $$$s_j = \texttt{cd}$$$, then in one operation of moving a letter from $$$i$$$ to $$$j$$$, you can do:

zh.ai: 例如，如果有 $$$s_i = \texttt{ab}$$$ 和 $$$s_j = \texttt{cd}$$$，那么在一次将一个字母从 $$$i$$$ 移动到 $$$j$$$ 的操作中，你可以进行如下操作：

segs.en: $$$s_i = \texttt{a}$$$; $$$s_j = \texttt{bcd}$$$ or $$$s_j = \texttt{cbd}$$$ or $$$s_j = \texttt{cdb}$$$.

zh.ai: $$$s_i = \texttt{a}$$$；$$$s_j = \texttt{bcd}$$$ 或 $$$s_j = \texttt{cbd}$$$ 或 $$$s_j = \texttt{cdb}$$$。

segs.en: $$$s_i = \texttt{b}$$$; $$$s_j = \texttt{acd}$$$ or $$$s_j = \texttt{cad}$$$ or $$$s_j = \texttt{cda}$$$.

zh.ai: $$$s_i = \texttt{b}$$$；$$$s_j = \texttt{acd}$$$ 或 $$$s_j = \texttt{cad}$$$ 或 $$$s_j = \texttt{cda}$$$。

segs.en: Note that it is also allowed to choose $$$i = j$$$ in the operation.

zh.ai: 注意，在操作中也允许选择 $$$i = j$$$。

segs.en: You need to replace the nameplates with names at each station as quickly as possible so that they correspond to the new names. Determine whether this is possible, and if so, the minimum necessary amount of time.

zh.ai: 你需要尽快将每个车站的站牌替换为对应的新名称。请判断这是否可能；若可能，求所需的最短时间。

segs.en: The first line of the test contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$) — the number of stations on the line.

zh.ai: 测试的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$)，表示线路上的站点数。

segs.en: The second line of the test contains $$$n$$$ strings: $$$s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n$$$ ($$$1 \le |s_i| \le 20$$$) — the original names of the stations.

zh.ai: 测试数据的第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个字符串：$$$s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n$$$($$$1 \le |s_i| \le 20$$$)——车站的原始名称。

segs.en: The third line of the test contains $$$n$$$ strings: $$$t_1, t_2, \ldots, t_n$$$ ($$$1 \le |t_i| \le 20$$$) — the desired new names of the stations.

zh.ai: 测试的第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个字符串：$$$t_1, t_2, \ldots, t_n$$$($$$1 \le |t_i| \le 20$$$)——车站期望的新名称。

segs.en: It is guaranteed that all strings in the test consist of lowercase Latin letters, characters from 'a' to 'z'.

zh.ai: 保证所有测试中的字符串均只由小写拉丁字母，即字符 'a' 到 'z' 组成。

segs.en: If there is no way to rename all the stations, output $$$-1$$$ in a single line. Otherwise, output a single number: the minimum possible total time required for the renaming operations.

zh.ai: 如果无法重命名所有车站，请在单独一行输出 $$$-1$$$。否则，输出一个整数：完成所有重命名操作所需的最小总时间。

segs.en: C. Olympiad Schedule

zh.ai: C. 奥林匹克竞赛日程安排

segs.en: Persik — a shark in the world of programming — decided to create a schedule for all tracks of the Innopolis Open olympiad.

zh.ai: Persik——编程世界中的一条鲨鱼——决定为 Innopolis Open 奥林匹克竞赛的所有赛道制定赛程。

segs.en: There are $$$D$$$ days in the academic year, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$D$$$. In total, $$$n$$$ olympiads are held.

zh.ai: 学年共有 $$$D$$$ 天，编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$D$$$。总共举办了 $$$n$$$ 场奥林匹克竞赛。

segs.en: The olympiads are numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ in non-decreasing order of their initially scheduled dates. Each olympiad takes place on exactly one day. For each olympiad, its initially scheduled date and its benefit for the younger generation are known.

zh.ai: 各届奥林匹克竞赛按照其最初预定日期的非递减顺序编号为 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$。每届竞赛恰好在一天内举行。对于每届竞赛，已知其最初预定日期以及其对年轻一代带来的收益。

segs.en: You may change the date of any olympiad, but only to a later day within the same academic year (that is, the new date cannot be earlier than the original one and cannot exceed $$$D$$$).

zh.ai: 你可以修改任意一场奥林匹克竞赛的日期，但只能改到同一学年内更晚的一天(即新日期不能早于原日期，且不能超过 $$$D$$$)。

segs.en: After all changes, the olympiads must remain in non-decreasing order of their scheduled dates.

zh.ai: 完成所有更改后，各场竞赛的安排日期必须保持非递减顺序。

segs.en: The total benefit of the olympiad season is defined as follows. For each day, consider all olympiads scheduled on that day. If at least one olympiad is scheduled on a given day, the benefit of that day is the maximum benefit among those olympiads. If no olympiads are scheduled on that day, the benefit of that day is $$$0$$$.

zh.ai: 奥林匹克竞赛季的总收益定义如下。对于每一天，考虑当天安排的所有竞赛。若某一天至少安排了一场竞赛，则该天的收益为这些竞赛中的最大收益。若当天没有安排任何竞赛，则该天的收益为 $$$0$$$。

segs.en: The benefit of the season is the sum of the benefits over all $$$D$$$ days.

zh.ai: 整个赛季的收益是所有 $$$D$$$ 天的收益之和。

segs.en: For the benefit of the students, determine the maximum possible total benefit of the season.

zh.ai: 为了学生的利益，求赛季总收益的最大可能值。

segs.en: The first line contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$D$$$, and $$$t$$$ — the number of olympiads and the number of days in the academic year, as well as the type of answer ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$; $$$1 \le D \le 2 \cdot 10^9$$$; $$$1 \le t \le 2$$$).

zh.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 $$$n$$$、$$$D$$$ 和 $$$t$$$——奥林匹克竞赛的数量、学年中的天数，以及答案类型($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$；$$$1 \le D \le 2 \cdot 10^9$$$；$$$1 \le t \le 2$$$)。

segs.en: In the $$$i$$$-th of the following $$$n$$$ lines, two integers $$$d_i$$$ and $$$b_i$$$ are given — the scheduled date (day number) of the $$$i$$$-th olympiad and its benefit ($$$1 \le d_i \le D$$$; $$$1 \le b_i \le 2 \cdot 10^9$$$).

zh.ai: 在接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行中的第 $$$i$$$ 行，给出两个整数 $$$d_i$$$ 和 $$$b_i$$$——第 $$$i$$$ 届奥林匹克竞赛的预定日期(天数)及其收益($$$1 \le d_i \le D$$$；$$$1 \le b_i \le 2 \cdot 10^9$$$)。

segs.en: It is guaranteed that $$$d_i \le d_j$$$ for all $$$i$$$ and $$$j$$$ such that $$$i  \lt  j$$$.

zh.ai: 保证对于所有满足 $$$i  \lt  j$$$ 的 $$$i$$$ 和 $$$j$$$，均有 $$$d_i \le d_j$$$。

segs.en: If $$$t = 1$$$, output a single integer — the maximum possible benefit of the olympiad season.

zh.ai: 如果 $$$t = 1$$$，输出一个整数——奥赛赛季可能获得的最大收益。

segs.en: If $$$t = 2$$$, then in the first line output a single integer — the maximum possible benefit of the olympiad season; and in the second line output the schedule of the olympiads — $$$n$$$ integers, where the $$$i$$$-th is the final date of the $$$i$$$-th olympiad. The specified final dates must achieve the maximum possible benefit of the olympiad season.

zh.ai: 如果 $$$t = 2$$$，则第一行输出一个整数——奥赛赛季可能获得的最大收益；第二行输出奥赛的赛程安排——$$$n$$$ 个整数，其中第 $$$i$$$ 个整数表示第 $$$i$$$ 场奥赛的决赛日期。所指定的决赛日期必须使奥赛赛季的收益达到最大可能值。

segs.en: The tests for this problem consist of thirteen groups. Points for each group are awarded only if all tests of the group and all tests necessary for it are passed.

zh.ai: 本题测试数据共分为十三组。只有通过某组中的所有测试以及该组所依赖的所有测试，才能获得该组的分数。

segs.en: Note that the answer for the second test will not be suitable as an answer for the first, as for $$$t = 1$$$ only one number needs to be output.

zh.ai: 注意，第二个测试用例的答案不适合作为第一个测试用例的答案，因为对于 $$$t = 1$$$，只需要输出一个数字。

segs.en: In the second example, the benefit of the first day is $$$3$$$, the benefit of the second is $$$5$$$, the third is $$$2$$$, and the benefits of days from the $$$4$$$th to the $$$10$$$th are $$$0$$$. Thus, the benefit of the olympiad season is $$$3+5+2+0+\ldots+0=10$$$. Note that the schedule of olympiads $$$[2, 1, 3]$$$ is not possible, as the olympiads must remain in non-decreasing order of their scheduled dates.

zh.ai: 在第二个样例中，第一天的收益为 $$$3$$$，第二天的收益为 $$$5$$$，第三天的收益为 $$$2$$$，而从第 $$$4$$$ 天到第 $$$10$$$ 天的收益为 $$$0$$$。因此，奥赛季的收益为 $$$3+5+2+0+\ldots+0=10$$$。注意，奥赛安排 $$$[2, 1, 3]$$$ 是不可能的，因为各场奥赛的安排日期必须保持非递减顺序。

segs.en: In the third example, a schedule of olympiads $$$[1, 2, 5, 6, 6]$$$ is also suitable, but $$$[1, 2, 3, 5, 6]$$$ is not suitable, as the third olympiad cannot take place before the $$$5$$$th day

zh.ai: 在第三个样例中，奥林匹克竞赛的安排 $$$[1, 2, 5, 6, 6]$$$ 也是合适的，但 $$$[1, 2, 3, 5, 6]$$$ 不合适，因为第三场奥林匹克竞赛不能在第 $$$5$$$ 天之前举行。

segs.en: M. Binary String Counting 2026

zh.ai: M. 二进制字符串计数 2026

segs.en: Yes, this is yet another problem about counting binary strings.

zh.ai: 是的，这又是一道关于计数二进制字符串的题目。

segs.en: You are given a string $$$s$$$ consisting of $$$n$$$ characters; each character is either 1 or 0. Also, you are given an integer $$$k$$$.

zh.ai: 给定一个由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串 $$$s$$$；每个字符要么是 1，要么是 0。此外，给定一个整数 $$$k$$$。

segs.en: You can perform up to $$$k$$$ (possibly zero) operations on string $$$s$$$. Each operation has to be of one of three types:

zh.ai: 你可以对字符串 $$$s$$$ 执行至多 $$$k$$$ 次(也可以是零次)操作。每次操作必须属于以下三种类型之一：

segs.en: choose an index $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and replace $$$s_i$$$ with its inverse (that is, if $$$s_i$$$ is 1, replace it with 0, and vice versa);

zh.ai: 选择一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的下标 $$$i$$$，并将 $$$s_i$$$ 替换为其相反值(即若 $$$s_i$$$ 为 1，则将其替换为 0，反之亦然)；

segs.en: sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-descending order (assuming that 1 is greater than 0);

zh.ai: 将字符串 $$$s$$$ 的字符按非递减顺序排序(假设 1 大于 0)；

segs.en: sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-ascending order (also assuming that 1 is greater than 0).

zh.ai: 将字符串 $$$s$$$ 中的字符按非升序排序(并规定 1 大于 0)。

segs.en: String $$$t$$$ is reachable if it is possible to obtain it from $$$s$$$ by applying no more than $$$k$$$ operations. You have to calculate the number of reachable strings $$$t$$$.
The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 150$$$; $$$0 \le k \le n$$$).
The second line contains $$$s$$$ — a string consisting of exactly $$$n$$$ characters. Each character is either 1 or 0.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$s$$$ —— 一个恰好由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串。每个字符都是 1 或 0。

segs.en: Print one integer — the number of reachable strings. Since the answer can be huge, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数——可达字符串的数量。由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 $$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
